name: Minimal Pitch
tagline: A quiet, confident investor deck: white canvas, one green accent, very large type and one idea per slide. Original slides-commons design.

palette.description: pure white canvas, near-black ink, hairline greys and a single deep green accent used once per slide

typography.style: one geometric grotesque in four weights: very large semibold headlines with tight tracking, regular body, small wide-tracked uppercase labels, tabular figures for numbers in columns

best_for: Seed to Series B pitch decks and any argument that should land one idea per slide: problem, solution, product, why now, market size (nested TAM/SAM/SOM circles), traction chart, business model, 2x2 competition, team, the ask with use of funds.
avoid_for: Dense reports, training material, data-heavy reviews with many tables, and loud keynote moments. The white space is the design; slides with more than one idea break it.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
